name: The Order's note
description: "Last work of I. — 'Of Enchantment' — poss. in Cannerly Hall [Mouldy Manor] — great honour in retr."

name: The candle's inscription
description: On its base: "As my hand gave an inescapable flame in life, so once it shall in death."
